subject.size_in_frame: still ten inches high, about 0.42 of frame height in the near-left ground

second_subject.note: the little glass box in the middle distance under the table, half in lamp shadow, about 0.30 of frame height — as tall as her chest.

headroom: about 0.24 of frame height above her, filled by the dark underside of the tabletop; the box has a little less, so the frame quietly gives the object the lower, heavier position.
horizon_eyeline: Lens on the flags at 0.20 m: the flagstone joints run away from the bottom of frame and give the floor its scale. Her eyeline is at 0.56, level, and travels across the frame to the box — a search, not a discovery.

layers.fg: flagstone joints and the mosaic dado border at her scale, left and bottom
layers.mg: Alice sniffing and looking about her
layers.bg: two enormous clear glass legs standing either side of the box, and the dark hall beyond

gaze.note: her look crosses the frame left to right and lands on the box; the lead room is exactly the distance between them and is occupied by empty floor, so the search reads as a search.

balance: Two objects of similar weight either side of centre with lit floor between them — a frame that invites comparison and then lets the eye make it unaided.
leading_lines: The flagstone joints rake from the lower left toward the box; the two glass legs bracket it like door jambs. The architecture delivers the box without any help from the camera.
eye_first: Alice — and then her look, which is what takes the eye to the box. The audience should find it the same way she does.
constraint_binding: Static — the box is found by her eye, not by a push-in, so it is placed in the composition from the first frame, in shadow, and is never revealed by a move. No re-lighting between S06 and S07: the lamp pools fall exactly where they fell in sh055's set-up. Deep focus, both planes sharp.
